summary: Standard chess vs Stockfish (3600) with a neutral rabbit, an anomaly from the SCP-4000 forest, on e4. After each of Stockfish's moves it makes its own move with the movement it has, then swaps places with a random adjacent piece and takes that piece's movement. One game; the narrator loses a lot, then parks pieces next to the rabbit on purpose, gets lucky swaps and wins by a swap-made double check and capturing the king (12:52-12:58).
rules: 0:14 The rabbit starts on e4; White is the player, Black is Stockfish. (site: rabbitSquare e4)
0:01, 0:40-0:51 After a move it first makes its own move, then can swap identities with any piece adjacent to it, swapping places and stealing its movement ability.
site: it acts only after Black's move (if c===ENGINE await rabbitTurn()); video: every swap called out follows the engine's move (1:25-1:37, 2:35, 2:47, 3:30, 3:39).
site: starting identity is a white king (rabbitAbility='wK').

0:51 'it can now move like a white pawn, meaning its only available next move is up to D5' - it moves with the copied piece's colour and direction; site: pseudo moves of that piece from its square, empty targets only, no castling, no en passant, so it never captures.
4:54 'it did gain the ability to move like my queen and then swapped with the pawn on D5'; 10:57 'we get it moving like a knight'.
8:46-8:53, 9:32, 9:45 stuck in a loop: swaps with a pawn, moves like a pawn back, swaps again (a pawn identity with no forward square cannot move; it then just swaps).

site: swap target = random occupied square among the 8 neighbours, either colour, kings included (4:28 'the king might get swapped with'); no neighbour = no swap (10:36-10:47 'place a piece directly adjacent to it ... we do break it free').
9:06 'the knight is kind of trapped because it can't move onto whatever we want to call this thing' - nothing can land on it; site: never a legal target, blocks sliding lines.
site: a pawn swapped onto its own last rank becomes a queen; castling rights cleared when a king or a home-corner rook is swapped; en passant cleared when spoiled.
5:58 'there is also a black pawn on the back rank' - a black pawn swapped onto rank 1 stays a pawn (not its promotion rank).
12:52-12:58 a swap creates a double check and White captures the king; site: capturing a king is legal and ends the game.
Otherwise normal chess; site promotion picker Q R B N.
win_condition: Checkmate, or capture a king a swap left in check (12:52). Draws as normal chess.
